summary: Automated baseline scan: type-check failures, lint warnings, TODOs indicating missing PostGIS wiring, and minor lint/security issues.

findings.title: Frontend TypeScript check failing (18 errors)
findings.description: TypeScript compiler reports 18 errors which break the CI 'type-check' step. Files include: frontend/src/components/DataStatusPanel.tsx, ExportPanel.tsx, MapView.tsx, RealtimePanel.tsx, src/repositories/GeoDataRepository.ts, among others.
findings.suggested_action: Prioritize fixing TypeScript errors by adding explicit types, handle 'unknown' values safely, and add unit tests that cover affected components. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' locally to reproduce. Consider adding CI gating to block merges until type-check passes.

findings.title: ESLint warnings (85) — many 'no-explicit-any'
findings.description: ESLint reports 85 warnings, predominantly '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any'. These reflect areas where types should be tightened for long-term maintainability.
findings.suggested_action: Where possible, replace 'any' with precise types or 'unknown' with runtime type guards. Add linter suppressions only with justifying comments. Consider an incremental migration plan to stricter typing.

findings.title: Site suitability module uses placeholder evaluators (multiple TODOs)
findings.description: app/spatial_analysis/site_suitability.py contains multiple TODO comments indicating missing PostGIS wiring for flood_zones, biodiversity, wetlands, open_spaces, zoning, road network, myciti_stops, urban_edge. These are core to the Suitability use case.
references: TODO: Wire to PostGIS ST_Intersects query against 'flood_zones' layer (MapServer/71)
TODO: Wire to PostGIS query against Critical Biodiversity Areas layer
TODO: Wire to PostGIS ST_Distance query against road network layer
TODO: Wire to PostGIS ST_Distance query against 'myciti_stops' layer
findings.suggested_action: Prioritize implementing PostGIS-backed evaluators and add unit/integration tests that use a test PostGIS dataset (Dockerized PostGIS fixture). Provide migration plan and scripts to seed minimal test data for deterministic tests.

findings.title: Admin endpoints unprotected when ADMIN_API_KEY is not set
findings.description: app/dependencies.py allows admin endpoints to be unprotected if settings.ADMIN_API_KEY is empty. This is convenient for local dev but risky for production if misconfigured.
findings.suggested_action: Add CI policy checks and documentation that require ADMIN_API_KEY to be set for protected branches/releases. Consider failing CI when ADMIN_API_KEY is empty on release branch builds, or add runtime enforcement toggled by ENV.

findings.title: Ruff: unused import in app/api/advanced_analysis_api.py
findings.description: ruff check reported unused import 'settings' in app/api/advanced_analysis_api.py at line ~16 (fixable).
findings.suggested_action: Apply quick fix: remove the unused import. Patch generated: patches/0001-remove-unused-import.patch

findings.title: Missing .github/policies/ — no policy-as-code detected
findings.description: Repository did not initially contain .github/policies/ with rules such as no-secrets, dependency-allowlist, max-pr-size, or protected-files. Agent added example policies and a policy_check script as a starting point.
findings.suggested_action: Review the generated policies, adjust patterns and severity for your organization, and integrate policy_check.js into CI. Consider using GitHub Policy-as-Code or OPA for stronger enforcement.

findings.title: Sample DB connection string with password in code
findings.description: app/core/database.py contains a sample DATABASE_URL/connection string in the warning message that includes 'geohub_password'. While this appears to be a placeholder, it may encourage accidental commits of real credentials. Recommend replacing with a clearly marked placeholder or reading it from env.
findings.suggested_action: Replace sample passwords with '<YOUR_PASSWORD>' or environment variable references in code examples and docs. Add a policy to block 'postgres://.*:.*@' connection strings in committed files unless they contain template variables.

findings.title: SonarQube not bound to workspace (IDE analysis not available)
findings.description: The SonarQube for IDE tool indicated the workspace is not bound to a SonarQube project. Without a bound SonarQube instance, security hotspot analysis cannot be performed in our agent runs.
findings.suggested_action: If SonarQube is used, configure Connected Mode or add a Sonar project and bind this workspace. Alternatively, configure GitHub Advanced Security or external scanning in CI.
